title: A First Book of the Hatchet
summary: Teaches a first-time student how to hold, carry and swing the hand axe using body strength alone.

title: Kindling and Cordwood Exercises
summary: Turns daily kindling and cordwood chopping into drills for a steady one-handed stroke by students with hardened skin.

title: Handbook of the One-Hand Chop
summary: Sets out the plain one-handed chops, guards and steps of the hand axe for students who have toughened the muscle.

title: The Belt-Axe Carrier's Manual
summary: Shows travellers and labourers how to draw, carry and use a hand axe worn at the belt.

title: Lessons in Wrist and Helve
summary: Trains the wrist, forearm and short helve grip so a student with strengthened tendons controls every cut and guard.

title: Hatchet Work for the Circulating Student
summary: Adds light circulation of qi to the hand axe's basic chop, guard and step for newly awakened students.

title: A Workbook of Short-Haft Guards
summary: Drills the guards and parries of a short helve, with a thread of qi in the grip.

title: Brush-Cutter's Drill Canon
summary: Adapts the clearing strokes of brush cutters into basic hand axe attacks for students who circulate qi.

title: Treatise on the Close-Quarter Hatchet
summary: Teaches the cramped chops, shoves and hooks of the hand axe at arm's length to students who circulate qi.

title: Practice Sheets for Hook and Chop
summary: Pairs the hand axe's chop with its hooking pull in sheets of repeated drills, with light qi in the arm.

title: The Plain Hatchet Reader
summary: A short reader giving a circulating student the five working strokes and guards every hand axe user needs.
